simon-beats: Adds five content categories: TILs, releases, museums, tools and research.
The beats name and workflow refer to the author own blogging practice.
simon-twenty-years: Contains a history of projects and writing across twenty years.
simon-2022-projects: A month-by-month account of 2022 projects and blogging.
Datasette Lite runs the Python application in the browser with WebAssembly and Pyodide.
simon-what-to-blog: Recommends writing about projects and things recently learned.
These are recommendations by the author, not universal requirements.
simon-link-blog: Link blogging dates back to November 2003.
Blogmarks combine a title, URL, commentary and attribution via links.
simon-datasette-blog: Announces an official Datasette project blog.
Author reports building it with Codex desktop and valuing Markdown session transcripts.
